verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that an HMRC sign-in page exists ('HMRC online services: sign in or set up an account'). Nothing describes the authentication method: no credential MFA, no remote completion, and no statement ruling out biometric, in-person or postal-PIN verification. The employer-registration letter is a registration step, not a description of the sign-in method, so it neither confirms nor contradicts the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
